front: A small wooden chest appears and opens; it holds up to 10 Bulk. Closing it turns it into a key that takes the contents with it. The key can bring the chest back once.
back:
1. Use the miniature: a small wooden chest appears and immediately opens. It holds up to 10 Bulk.
2. Close it: it transforms into a key, taking all stored items with it.
3. Interact to turn the key in an imaginary lock: it becomes a chest again with all items still inside.
After becoming a chest the second time, it remains a wooden chest forever.
